evals.prompt: Zrób brandbook dla naszych herbat ziołowych Tatarak. W folderze masz brief, logo, arkusz produktów i obecną etykietę rumianku. Grafik ma z tego zrobić etykiety na trzy puszki, a ja chcę coś, co pokażę wspólnikowi. Bez pytań, rób na założeniach.
evals.expected_output: A brand/ folder with brand.json, the interactive book (book/index.html), three label templates (labels/*.html) with PDFs and PNGs, tokens.css, a PDF of the book of at most 20 pages, 00-input.md, 01-verify.md and 02-system.md, and a reply with the direction, the palette and typefaces with reasons, the placeholders and open decisions, what wasn't checked and the commands to rebuild.
assertions: check_brand.py and render.mjs check end without errors on the final brand/ folder
brand/book/index.html opens from disk, has the reader filter and both parts (brand, rules), and its sections were viewed at 1440 and 390 px (out/shots/sections/)

There are three label templates (lipa, rumianek, pokrzywa) of 260 × 60 mm with bleed, each with the net quantity on the front, all mandatory food keys filled, and the lot given as printed on the bottom of the tin
The PDF of the book has at most 20 pages, as the brief asked

01-verify.md lists the two spellings (Tatarak in the brief and logo, Tatarák in the sheet), the net quantity 50 g on the old label against 40 g in the sheet, the net quantity missing from the old front, the plant claim about immunity and sleep, the small print below 1.2 mm x-height, the date form without 'końcem', and says who decides each
No health claim appears in brand.json, the book or the labels without a register_ref, and the plant claim from the old label isn't reused
Every colour has HEX, RGB, CMYK with a named profile and a status, and Pantone is either given or an open decision with a person and a date
The typefaces have a written reason, a licence file and the Polish letters (render.mjs check reports no missing glyphs); none is from the reflex list without reflex_reason
The palette is not the model default (cream with terracotta, near-black with an acid accent) and the green differs from a generic eco green, with the reason in 02-system.md
The name 'Herbaciarnia Wzorcowa' appears nowhere in the book, the labels or tokens.css
The logo comes from the supplied file and isn't redrawn; the reply or 01-verify.md notes that the logo file uses live text in Georgia and should be outlined by a designer
The reply lists the assumptions made without questions, the open decisions with people and dates, what wasn't checked (printer's proof, legal review, images) and the commands to rebuild

evals.prompt: Dodaj czwartą herbatę: Mięta pieprzowa, 30 g, w tej samej puszce, skład liść mięty pieprzowej 100%. Ma mieć nowy kolor wariantu.
evals.expected_output: The existing brand/ folder updated through brand.json only: a fourth label and colour, the book rebuilt with the new label and the colour in the palette and contrast matrix, checks without errors.
assertions: Only brand.json was edited by hand; book/index.html and labels/ were rebuilt by build_book.py (no hand edits reported by the build)
There is a fourth label of the same format and layout, with the net quantity 30 g on the front and all mandatory food keys
The new colour has CMYK with a profile and a status that isn't proofed, and it appears in the palette and the contrast matrix of the book
check_brand.py and render.mjs check end without errors
The changelog has a new version entry

evals.prompt: czy obecna etykieta rumianku jest zgodna z prawem? możemy ją dalej drukować?
evals.expected_output: A reply that doesn't give a legal verdict: the points from labels-eu.md found on the label, each with why it matters, and that the client's regulatory person decides.
assertions: The reply doesn't say the label is legal or illegal; it says a regulatory person decides
It names at least: the small print below 1.2 mm x-height, the net quantity not next to the name, the plant claim, the date form, and the 50 g against 40 g mismatch
It doesn't build a full brand book for this question

evals.prompt: Zrób brandbook dla mojej firmy grzewczej. W folderze jest moja wiadomość, teksty z obecnej strony, opinie z Google i logo. Teksty na stronie są do niczego, chcę wiedzieć, jak mamy pisać. Bez pytań, rób na założeniach.
evals.expected_output: A brand/ folder for a service brand without labels: brand.json, the book (book/index.html) with the quick reference after the cover, a PDF of at most 20 pages, tokens.css, 00-input.md, 01-verify.md and 02-system.md, and a reply with the direction, what the book says about writing, the open decisions and what wasn't checked.
assertions: check_brand.py and render.mjs check end without errors on the final brand/ folder; labels is empty and the book doesn't mention labels

The second slide is the quick reference: the logo, the core colours, the typeface with its office substitute, up to five rules, the owner's contact and where the current version lives (or an open decision about it)

strategy.audience and strategy.alternatives come from the brief (the cheaper crews from OLX, the installer the manufacturer recommends, doing nothing out of fear of the subsidy or an old house) and both are visible in the book

voice.situations has at least four moments from the firm's work (a quote, a subsidy question, a breakdown call, a delay, a bad review or a complaint), each with the line the firm writes and the one it doesn't, and they appear on a slide

voice.boilerplate has a one-sentence and an about-fifty-word description built from facts in the files (since 2014, 212 heat pumps, the audit before installation), with none of the site's phrases (kompleksowe, najwyższej jakości, z pasją, partner w biznesie, innowacyjne)
strategy.proof entries have a source and a date (4,9 from 87 reviews as of 10.10.2026, 212 pumps as of 30.09.2026, 131 of 140 applications approved)

The site's promises 'gwarantujemy dotację', 'najniższe ceny na rynku' and 'serwis 24/7' are not reused: the book promises help with the application, not the subsidy, and 01-verify.md lists them with who confirms what may be promised
logo.partners states how the manufacturers' logos stand next to the firm's (the firm's logo leads), and 01-verify.md asks who confirms permission to use them on the van and the site
meta.company has the name, the NIP and the address from the brief and no KRS or share capital (a sole trader)
No field names, build paths, tool names or the agency's name appear in the book outside the cover (render.mjs check reports none)
The PDF of the book has at most 20 pages
The logo comes from the supplied SVG and isn't redrawn; 01-verify.md or the reply notes the live text in Arial to be outlined by a designer
render.mjs check reports no slide with more than 90 words of prose, and the book has about 1,500 words of prose or fewer
